output.summary: Arts' slow service is not general deprioritisation. Category- and priority-matched Arts tickets are within 0.3 days of non-Arts. About 70% of the median gap comes from SlotBook tickets routed to the P4 best-effort queue under RR-17. They wait a median 17 days before first action. Most of the rest comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site cover at Lindqvist, and Education shows the same pattern. Arts' higher volume is not fully explained by SlotBook and is not driven by duplicates. The ACK-P4 template hides the best-effort status from requesters. Whether ITS told Arts leadership of RR-17 cannot be established. Preferred next steps are a written support agreement, a fixed acknowledgement and matched reporting. Decommissioning SlotBook or creating an Arts desk is premature.
